name: @wowarenalogs/pipeline-app
description: wal-pilot: tray app hosting the log-streaming (Windows) and collect+analyze (macOS) pipeline roles
author: WoW Arena Logs

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --outfile=dist/main.js && shx cp src/wizard.html src/preload.js dist/ && shx cp ../tools/src/dashboard/index.html dist/dashboard.html
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('electron/package.json').version") --mac dmg --arm64 && electron-builder --config.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('electron/package.json').version") --win nsis --x64
